title: Get Built
author: Micah W.
desc: A 12 Week plan to cover the entire body. If you stick closely to the plan you will be greatly rewarded for you efforts.

ex.note: Focus on getting a deep stretch with each rep

MyoRep Match:

MyoRep Match is doing 1 full set, resting, and every set after that HAS to Match the number of reps that you got on the first set.
Keep your back almost parallel to the floor, deep stretch every single rep, don't put the bar down between reps
Deep stretch, bring the bar down to your chest

The 2 handed cable rows work well.

Meadows row are not the most intuitive until you’ve got your basic row form mastered… then it’s awesome

Work on your form with this one. Record yourself. Do 4 sets with the bar to practice perfect form, then do something else like a Goblet Squat or Hack Squat to actually work the muscles (room to cheat)
Barbell, Smith, etc. Be sure to pause for a full second at the top of each rep, and go all the way down, getting as deep of a stretch as possible without moving your feet or coming off the bench.

MyoReps:
2 sets of MyoReps (at the end of each set)
Last set = Drop set (As many reps as possible)

MyoRep Match

Don’t cheat, get a full stretch each rep
Overhand, normal grip
Machine, T-Bar, or DB on an incline bench is good too
Add weight once you can get 20
Back parallel to the floor, focus on your rear delts, don’t swing, use control
Go light, you can either bend at the hips, or kneel to lean on a bench or a Yoga ball (its weird but has saved me from a lot of back and shoulder pain over the years)

Each leg. 

Or some other single leg squat/quad movement
Preferably seated, and really focused on the stretch, but lying is okay if that’s what your gym has.
Legs lower and closer together, keep the back arched, don’t cheat unless you’re about to get pinned.
